waves.1: Pipeline validation. AI 議事録 おすすめ and 文字起こし AI おすすめ are affiliate_ready and template_ready today, so they prove the affiliate path end to end; CRM おすすめ opens cluster E on the same roundup template; HubSpot 料金 and AI 議事録 比較 unblock as soon as the pricing and comparison_listicle templates land. Each roundup becomes the cluster hub that later waves link back to.
waves.2: Cluster reinforcement. Builds the A pillar (AI 議事録) and hangs its 無料, 料金 and 使い方 children off it, adds the Make how-to and pricing pair for the commission-wired primary program, and gives B and E one commercial node each. Children link up to their pillar and the pillar links down to the Wave 1 roundups.
waves.3: Topic authority. Completes the RPA sub-cluster, opens D as a supporting-only cluster, and adds the two highest-volume C and B anchors. AI エージェント and AI 業務効率化 act as cross-cluster hubs connecting the B pillar, the C automation nodes and the D generative-AI nodes.
